title: Truth above all
summary: Receive truth and renounce untruth in every part of life.
summaryHi: जीवन के प्रत्येक क्षेत्र में सत्य को ग्रहण करना और असत्य का त्याग करना।
detail: God is the efficient cause of all true knowledge and all that is known through knowledge. Truthful inquiry is the foundation of spiritual and civic life.

title: Knowledge for all
summary: Let knowledge be shared, pursued, and made accessible to every person.
summaryHi: ज्ञान का प्रसार करना और बिना किसी भेदभाव के सभी के लिए सुलभ बनाना।
detail: Arya Samaj champions universal literacy, Gurukul and modern education, and the removal of ignorance.

title: Thoughtful discernment
summary: Hold every belief to the light of reason and the wisdom of the Vedas.
summaryHi: प्रत्येक मान्यता को तर्क और वेदों के ज्ञान की कसौटी पर परखना।
detail: The Vedas are the scripture of all true knowledge. Every Arya is called to read, teach, and reflect on them with clear reason.

title: Do what is right
summary: Choose dharma: actions guided by truth, justice, and integrity.
summaryHi: सत्य, न्याय और ईमानदारी से प्रेरित धर्मानुकूल आचरण चुनना।
detail: All actions should be performed in accordance with Dharma—only after deliberating what is right and wrong.

title: Act for the world
summary: Work for the physical, spiritual, and social wellbeing of all.
summaryHi: सभी के शारीरिक, आत्मिक और सामाजिक कल्याण के लिए कार्य करना।
detail: The primary object of Arya Samaj is to do good to the whole world—improving physical, spiritual, and social conditions alike.

title: Care for one another
summary: Let our conduct be shaped by love, fairness, and respect.
summaryHi: हमारा व्यवहार सभी के प्रति प्रेम, निष्पक्षता और सम्मान से प्रेरित हो।
detail: Our conduct towards all should be guided by love, righteousness, and justice.

title: Share in goodness
summary: Support knowledge and prosperity through generous, responsible action.
summaryHi: उदार और उत्तरदायी कर्मों द्वारा विद्या और समृद्धि को बढ़ाना।
detail: We should dispel ignorance (Avidya) and promote knowledge (Vidya) for collective upliftment.

title: Grow in wisdom
summary: Pursue learning and help others grow, without distinction.
summaryHi: बिना किसी भेदभाव के स्वयं सीखना और दूसरों की उन्नति में सहायक बनना।
detail: No one should be content with promoting only their own good; each should look for their own good in the good of all.

title: Honor every voice
summary: Respect the freedom to seek truth and hold a considered view.
summaryHi: सत्य की खोज की स्वतंत्रता और सामाजिक कल्याणकारी नियमों का सम्मान।
detail: Everyone should abide by rules made for the general wellbeing of society, while remaining free in matters of personal conscience and wellbeing.

title: Serve with purpose
summary: Put the good of all before narrow, individual gain.
summaryHi: संकीर्ण व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ से ऊपर उठकर सबके हित में सेवा करना।
detail: Selfless service (Seva) binds individual spiritual growth with the harmony and dignity of the wider community.
